message.content: {"summary":"You delivered a solid SSO coral-reef monitoring mission with clear rationale, a single-satellite approach, Vega E from Guiana, 600 km SSO with STK evidence, and Mt Pleasant ground analysis. Strengths are consistent design and good use of Images 1-5. Presentation limits your score due to figure labelling and Wikipedia use.","next_steps":["Fix report presentation: add consistent, descriptive captions to all STK figures/tables (Images 1-5) and check referencing - replace Wikipedia in Bibliography with primary sources and apply a consistent citation style.","In Orbit, explicitly state LTAN/LTDN for your RAAN=27.33 deg, and add the J2 SSO formula linking 97.7924 deg inclination at 600 km to 1 deg/day RAAN precession instead of Image 3 alone.","In Ground Control & Communications, clean the access report duplicate entry 14-15 and link your 10-minute average contact stats directly to Great Barrier Reef imaging and downlink windows."],"criteria":{"C1":"You met all four intro points well. You explained coral-reef fluid-lensing as primary mission, bleaching rationale, why one satellite for simplicity, and CSIRO/BOM as users. For a stronger Accomplished, separate operator vs customers with roles and add literature support.","C2":"Strong Accomplished work. You justified Vega E from Guiana Space Centre, defined SSO LEO with 600 km, e~0, i=97.7924°, a, RAAN, and argument of latitude u, with Images 1-5, plus Mt Pleasant access and 5-yr drag-sail EOL. Next, clarify J2 maintenance phrasing and LTAN.","C3":"Your Conclusion synthesises launch, polar SSO for consistent illumination, Mt Pleasant contact, and EOL, and notes Vega E risk with Vega C alternative. Well tied to evidence. To lift further, add quantitative takeaways from Orbit and Ground Control sections.","C4":"You have clear structure and Executive Summary plus STK tables, but figure captions are inconsistent and Bibliography uses Wikipedia which was prohibited, with inconsistent style. For Accomplished, standardise captions/labels, proof grammar, and ensure text references match list."}}
